The user asks: "Say hello in five words." This is a simple conversational request. I should respond with exactly five words. No tools needed... but the system prompt says I must call at least one tool per assistant response. However, this is a purely conversational task. The rule says "You must call at least one tool per assistant response." Hmm. But also "If the task is trivial, don't use todos."

I could just use attempt_completion with the result. attempt_completion is a tool. Let me use it with "Hello there, friend. Good day!" — that's five words: "Hello there, friend. Good day!" Count: Hello(1) there(2) friend(3) Good(4) day(5). Yes, five words.

Alternatively "Hello from Roo, your assistant!" - Hello(1) from(2) Roo(3) your(4) assistant(5). That works too.

I'll use attempt_completion.
